thread:
Harper Nguyen: Postmortem follow-up: eviction cascade caused repeated fallback to the tiny model. Hotfix mitigated immediate impact. We need a trimmed runbook, owners for remediation, and a short automation to surface early eviction signs.
Mei Chen: I can do the runbook. Will produce a 1-page triage flow + exact pasteable commands and escalation steps. Target PR by Thu EOD.
Diego Alvarez: I'll own the automation and alerts. Plan: add a Prometheus alert for evictions + a small diagnostic script that oncall can run. ETA next Wed.
Harper Nguyen: Suggested triage steps to include: 1) confirm affected routes, 2) collect diag bundle, 3) check kv_cache and node pressure, 4) warm fallback if needed, 5) page SRE. Keep it minimal.
Mei Chen: Draft triage checklist I'll add (short commands):
```
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference describe pod $POD | egrep -i "evict|oom|pressure"
kubectl -n inference logs $POD -c inference --tail=250
curl -s localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit_ratio
```
And node checks: `journalctl -u kubelet | grep -i evict --no-pager | tail -n 100`
Diego Alvarez: For alerts, I'll propose two thresholds:
- page @sre-oncall when >2 pods evicted in a pool within 10m
- page @infra-lead when fallback route used >1x in 30m
I'll add PromQL snippets to the runbook so oncall can copy-paste.
Harper Nguyen: Also need a small regression check for model quality when fallback is used. Add a synthetic that runs a 10-prompt set and alerts if overall score drops >1%.
Mei Chen: Will include the synthetic instructions and a rollback recipe for autoscaler and batching changes. Runbook PR will include canned Slack templates for pages.
On-call Bot: Created INF-6239 "Eviction playbook + early alerting" and assigned Mei, Diego, Harper.
Diego Alvarez: Spike plan: test cache TTLs [20s,40s,60s] and batch caps [48,56] under load this Fri 09:00 PT. If a candidate reduces eviction rate with <1% p99 increase we pick for sprint. Will post results in INF-6239.
Mei Chen: Runbook PR target Thu EOD. Diego to post alert drafts by next Wed. Harper to schedule 15-min sync after the spike (Fri 11:30 PT) to decide sprint scope.
Harper Nguyen: Thanks. Please update INF-6239 with concrete due dates and any infra blockers. We'll reconvene after the spike. :white_check_mark:
